text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I know you shouldn't neglect even a minor injury, but don't you think you're worrying a little too much?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Is this part of your duty as a trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, if you're asking if it hurts or not, I'll tell you it certainly does.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's not so bad that I can't walk… Well, I'll have you carry me home anyway.
choice_data_list: I'm not going easy on you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's not so bad that I can't walk… Well, I'll have you carry me home anyway.
choice_data_list: I'm not going easy on you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good grief… I guess being so serious comes along with being a worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I was only half joking. But if you insist!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I carry Agnes Tachyon back to her dorm while keeping an eye on her injury.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! If you were really worried about me, you'd at least do that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Now, I don't want to walk anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I succumb to her moping and wind up carrying her back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're pretty harsh for one who's supposed to be worried.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If you're going to be mean, you could at least patch me up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Maybe I can learn a thing or two from your treatment techniques.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon observes me with a smile. From the look on her face, it seems like she might have learned something.
